summary: COHEIR™ v1.1 fully verified. Backend: 39/39 pytest cases pass (27 regression from iter1 + 12 new for uploads/share-kits/providers/analytics/alumni). Frontend: all new pages render with expected data-testids — Alumni (Jordan Blake + Priya Desai + Lifetime Relationship Principle), Portfolio (choose-file, 6 category chips, 3 visibility chips), Share Kits (all 7 kit-kind buttons, create flow works and lists new kit), Integrations (7 video + 5 calendar provider cards, Connect click logs pending request), Analytics (all 12 analytics panels render), Public Share /p/{slug} renders subject payload with ANCRID Verified/name/disciplines/awards/credits WITHOUT auth, and gracefully shows 'Share link unavailable' for unknown slugs (no auth redirect). Session detail has integration link. Sidebar has all 5 new nav testids (nav-alumni-link, nav-portfolio-link, nav-sharekits-link, nav-analytics-link, nav-integrations-link).

issues: Recharts 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on first paint — panels still render correctly but console shows ~24 warnings. Consider wrapping ResponsiveContainer with a fixed min-height parent to silence.

critical_code_review_comments: share_kits.py can_generate boolean logic on lines 54-59 is hard to parse due to operator precedence between `or` and `and` — consider extracting to a helper. Not a bug because the self-share override on line 61 covers the primary flow.
uploads.py uses synchronous `requests` inside async endpoints — fine for the current scale but will block the event loop under load. Consider aiohttp/httpx.AsyncClient for object storage calls.

analytics.py loads full users/sessions/reviews/opportunities/portfolio_files into memory to aggregate — acceptable at seed scale (<1k docs) but should move to Mongo aggregation pipelines at real scale.
Recharts panels render with width=-1 initially — parent grid sometimes has no explicit min-height; adding min-h-[280px] on the wrapping div would silence the warning.
test_credentials: See /app/memory/test_credentials.md — demo1234 for all accounts. Profile URL is /profile/:userId (not /professionals/:userId).
seed_data_creation: Created a share_kit (student_profile) and a press_kit during tests. Provider connection requests seeded. Test data is minimal and non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public share React page uses axios directly (no api instance) so bearer/cookie auth is not sent — verified. Slug 'creator-launch-20' is NOT seeded; UI shows 'Share link unavailable' 404 state which is expected. Recharts width warnings are cosmetic. Profile URL is /profile/:userId, not /professionals/:userId. Backend uses sync requests for object storage which is OK at demo scale.
